dct_description_sm: This dataset summarizes the information received from companies reporting under the Reduction in the Release of Volatile Organic Compounds Regulations (Petroleum Sector). It includes fenceline monitoring results for petroleum refineries in Canada. The information was provided to Environment and Climate Change Canada under the Canadian Environmental Protection Act, 1999.
dct_title_s: Data collected under the Reduction in the Release of Volatile Organic Compounds Regulations (Petroleum Sector)
